tasks.title: Impact propagation: edge-type policy, confidence decay, reason chains (AC3,AC13)
tasks.dispositionReason: propagate.ts: edge-type policy with confidence decay as the bound, reason chains on every page, renames also reach the old path's page (AC3,AC13 input). Measured on the real graph: hub signature change reaches 37/50 pages in 5ms, recorded in journal. 16 tests

tasks.title: Both freshness paths: git range and VerifiedScope fallback (AC11,AC12)
tasks.dispositionReason: page-freshness.ts: git-log path when VerifiedAt resolves, VerifiedScope fallback otherwise, findings from the hash path capped at review-suggested; unreachable revision falls through rather than erroring (AC11,AC12). 11 tests
